items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Then I went to Ray and I said Raymond this is not nice of you people to do this to me, how can you actually think that you can pay a man ten dollars for all this work.

ctx.x: Yes. I really was deeply hurt by that. Then I went to Ray and I said Raymond this is not nice of you people to do this

to me, how can you actually think that you can pay a man ten dollars for all this work. He didn't want to know about it. Harvey handles that, and talk to Harvey. I couldn't handle these fast talking people; I have trouble enough today handling a fast talker, except that I have no problem recognizing them anymore.
